bug_report:
[12/13/14 Regression] Missed vectorization under -mavx512f -mavx512vl afterr12-5489
cat vect.c

typedef unsigned char uint8_t;                                                               
                                                                                             
static uint8_t x264_clip_uint8( int x )                                                      
{                                                                                            
    return x&(~255) ? (-x)>>31 : x;                                                          
}                                                                                            
                                                                                             
void mc_weight( uint8_t * __restrict dst, uint8_t * __restrict src, int i_width, int i_scale)
{                                                                                            
  for( int x = 0; x < i_width; x++ )                                                         
    dst[x] = x264_clip_uint8(src[x] * i_scale);                                              
}                                                                                            

It can not be vectorized with -mavx512f -mavx512vl, but can be vectorized with -mavx2, Seehttps://godbolt.org/z/M1jx161f6The commithttps://gcc.gnu.org/cgi-bin/gcc-gitref.cgi?r=r12-5489converts  (x & (~255)) == 0 to x <= 255, which may trigger some missing pattern with -mavx512vl. 

Also an 1.5% regression was found on -march=cascadelake due to missing 128bit epilogue for this loop.
